commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'FULL_PNPM_CHECK'
pnpm check >/tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-186-check.log 2>&1 || {
 echo 'CHECK_FAILED'
 grep -E 'FAIL|Error|Test Files|Tests |budget' /tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-186-check.log | tail -72 || true
 tail -80 /tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-186-check.log
 exit 54
}
echo 'PNPM_CHECK_PASS'
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-plug-confirm-186-check.log | tail -54 || true
echo 'CAPACITOR_SYNC_AND_ANDROID_ASSEMBLE'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK" | tr -d ' ')"
echo 'WORKTREE';git status --short
uptime
